membership_rule: Includes formal federal agency actions targeting institutional or programmatic accreditors for complete withdrawal of recognition; excludes voluntary relinquishments or minor probationary renewals without terminal revocation orders.

skeleton: Federal accreditation review cycles spanning 30 years encompassing dozens of renewal reviews, filtered by those reaching a formal staff recommendation for termination, multiplied by the fraction resulting in a final executed Secretary order within a 39-day window.
